title: startFeature creates a workflow record
action: startFeature (state.mjs) creates a workflow record via workflow-store instead of seizing the global pipeline: preconditions re-scoped to live workflows only (feature-name collision against non-terminal workflows, claimed cells of THIS feature, handoff naming this feature). Legacy --as-lane path becomes an alias onto workflow creation (lane record still written as projection for compat). Lock: workflow:<id> for the new record; the global 'state' lock is only touched to write the compat projection. Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors). Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed).

truths: two different features start concurrently without LOCK_BUSY on 'state' (test)
precondition failures name the conflicting workflow
lane alias still passes existing lane tests
prohibitions: no removal of existing startFeature refusal semantics for the SAME feature

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check
